items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: That was Georgie Parker. Yeah. I played with plenty of good ones, but I'd rather work with him than any of them.

ctx.x: Parade. It was his job, but it was really Maurice Duran's band. That's right. Tom Copeland used to get that job. Tom Copeland used to work at the Arabi packing companies. He'd cut meat. He used to get that job every day.

What you call him playing bass drum? What you call him? Parker, remember that? Big tall Parker. Parker. He died then. That was a good bass. He died then. Tom Parker. Tom Parker, yeah. That was a good one. I don't know.
